chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Waddad, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Muslim man inherits his dhimmi (non-Muslim protected) wife, but she does not inherit him.'
ai.seo_question: Does a Muslim man inherit from his non-Muslim wife according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the asymmetry in inheritance between a Muslim man and his non-Muslim *dhimmi* wife, a ruling derived from the general principle that differences in religion prevent mutual inheritance. This specific exception for *Ahl al-Kitab* (People of the Book) distinguishes their status from polytheists (*Mushrikun*), whose spouses do not inherit from Muslims, thereby reinforcing the theological hierarchy of faith in Shia jurisprudence.
